name: Josephine
text: Our family of five had an incredible stay at the Chilax Cabin. The thoughtfulness that went into creating an awesome experience was evident from the moment we arrived. The cabin itself is beautiful, with a well-maintained interior that made us feel right at home. The property outside is equally stunning, offering a peaceful and relaxing environment. The hosts were very responsive and ensured that the cabin was well-stocked with everything we needed for our stay. We highly recommend staying at this property for anyone looking for a perfect getaway.

name: Shawnee
text: We had an amazing family vacation! The location was beautiful, clean and we loved the creek!

name: Debra
text: We had a lovely time relaxing at the Chilllax cabin. It is very dog friendly. All the special touches made us all feel right at home . Looking forward to another visit.

name: Kayla
text: I would give this 10 stars if I could!! Unpack and Chillax was the most amazing Airbnb my family and I have ever stayed at! The pictures do not do it justice! It is even more beautiful and accommodating than it looks in the photos. Every single detail was carefully thought about. You literally only need groceries and your bug spray. The cabin is fully equipped with everything to cook with, all the games, cozy atmosphere and thoughtful things like a smores bar. My family and I had the best time and even though our dogs snuck off, Alton and Mary were rockstars in quickly getting the message out and we found our dogs within like 30 minutes. They had great communication and even allowed us to check in early. We are already missing it and planning our next trip. If you have any hesitations, DON’T just book the trip! ❤️

name: Meredith
text: We visit many Airbnbs around the world and this was definitely one of the best! It is clean, perfect location, private lot, wonderful amenities, lovely hosts, and they allow dogs AND have EV charging! Literally could not be better if they tried! We drove away at check out and were already planning our next getaway there! :)

name: Robin
text: Wonderful place host is very kind and helpful Very relaxing place for families to get away

name: Oscar
text: Great responsive hosts! Close to downtown Blue ridge and ideal for anyone looking for a golf trip over at Old Tocoa Farms!

name: Lauren
text: The Chillax Cabin was very nice it truly exceeded our expectations. It was extremely clean, honestly the cleanest Airbnb we have stayed at. It is nicely decorated and it felt very homey. There was lots to do for the kids, smores, creek, and they loved the game room and built in beds. We felt right at home here and wish we stayed longer. We would definitely stay at the Chillax Cabin again when in the area.

name: John
text: I first want to start out and say Mary was an outstanding Host, she responded in minutes. I was looking for a cabin big enough for my wife, her parents, my parents and I with some water for my three labs, So, they loved the creek that ran right by the property. Short story there were so many wild animals while we were walking along the creek, pepper started chasing a baby deer down through the creek and the other labs had to join in and mama deer were chasing them, while me and wife were chasing them all, felt like a movie. But the happy ending we all caught up together and baby deer was fine and left with mama deer, and they probably had a memory like ours worth sharing also. And we seen allot of deer and the baby deer feeding in the back when we woke. About the location very secluded, only seen neighbors sometimes across the creek but very friendly as is the rooster lol. The pictures do it no justice it is very beautiful. The fireplace outside is massive, and great for smores.

name: Abigail
text: Perfect cabin for me and my family! We had a fun and relaxing stay and made great use of the amenities. It had all the essentials with thoughtful additions that we thoroughly enjoyed and appreciated. The smores kit, the matching robes, the board games, blender, the grill, the extra dog leash, tv in every room. What a wonderful cabin! Both the kids and adults used the game room and hot tub a great deal, not to mention the kitchen. The creek and bonfire was a nice plus. Well stocked, well maintained and just awesome!
